{{Mergeto|Telekinesis/Legends}}
'''Telekinesis''' was an [[Ee mental power]], and part of the physical skills category. It was different from the [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] used by [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]]; Ee adept in this power could move objects although with greater difficulty than those who could use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
